old:
NAME THE VERSION BY ITS SPELL_ID. Every public spell_id->object
      lookup (`get_spell_by_id`, `find_spell_by_id`) resolves any lineage
      spell_id to
      the spell AS IT EXISTS NOW - the currently ACTIVE member - which
      is documented and correct for what those verbs are for. So a
      parked version is never fetched as an object: `notch_spell` takes
      its spell_id and resolves the exact version inside the call. The
      Spellbook is still not the surface you notch from - the conduit's
      verb does the resolving (owner ruling 2026-10-16; until then the
      verb took only the parked OBJECT, no public door handed one out,
      and this lesson stopped at staging).
